text:
Animal travel needs careful handling from the first check-in to the cabin handoff.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
Purpose: This section sets the desk steps for accepting, documenting, and releasing companion animals traveling with Aurelia Skyways.

At the counter, speak in a calm, friendly way and verify the traveler name, pet name, and travel details against the booking before any acceptance. For boarding, use FM-597 at the desk and place it with the travel packet before release. Confirm the carrier is secure, clean, and marked for the right cabin position, and make sure the owner understands that the cabin team monitors the animal after departure. If the traveler brings more than one approved pet, process each animal separately and keep the records separate as well.

For incident reporting, the Claim Adjudicator handles the report and records the next step. If you spot a delay, an animal distress issue, a carrier problem, or a document mismatch, pause the handoff, note the facts plainly, and tell the traveler what happens next without extra detail. Keep your tone steady and respectful, even when the line is busy, and route any unresolved service concern to the shift lead before the traveler leaves the desk. Do not promise an outcome that has not been cleared by the proper review path.

When the handoff is complete, file the packet, update the desk log, and check that the cabin crew has the final animal note. If you need support, contact the shift lead or the duty manager right away.
